notes.title: Update 1.8
notes.content:
Hello Players!
This month has been quite busy on the boring side of things, a lot bureaucracy behind the scenes kept me from developing the game further. But I don't want to bore you with that, so here are the new things/changes:

[list]
[*]new ghost behaviour! The ghosts articulations have been reworked, sometimes you have to deal with little ghost girls, sometimes you have to deal with big ghost boys. Enjoy!
[*]new ghost model was added along with some animations
[*]rearranged the EMF (sorry)
[*]made the toilet a little less prone to flushing
[/list]

notes.title: The "Welcome Back!"-Update
notes.content:
Reading and hearing your feedback was the greatest part of this last week. And it has inspired me to make another update for Ghostist. 
Let's start with what you came here for:

[h1]What has changed?[/h1]
- new music was added and some old music was cut
- the activity levels of different ghosts should now better reflect their personality
- gave the GIC some common sense ( I´d like some feedback on that )
- removed the social links
- fixed some noise-bugs
- changed some item prices(you get to keep your saved items though)
- made toilets flushable 

These might seem like rather minor changes, but under the hood a lot has changed. And it enables future features that I won't discuss just yet. This is not meant as a "Horse Armor DLC"(comment if you got that reference) but rather as a "Hey, I'm still here and I'm so happy that you are, too!"-Update. But that was too long a title, so [b]Welcome Back!-Update[/b] it is. 

Once again, I'm really happy you're here, and I hope you enjoy your time with Ghostist. I love watching you play my game :)

notes.title: Welcome, new players. Thank you, Insym.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello World! [/h1]
This recent week has been crazy. Insym, one of my favourite Phasmophobia-Youtubers made a video about Ghostist. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HNMILb_hTss&t=2829)

After that video came out Ghostist got a lot of love from you, the players. You helped a lot with your reviews, screenshots and comments, which made me very happy. This has been a passion project, and now being able to see more people enjoy that is the greatest thing one could wish for. 

[h1]Possible Future Updates[/h1]

I want to give back a little. I am thinking about another update, and i liked the suggestions Insym and some of you made. One thing I have to say first: Multiplayer is not something you can just include in a game, it is a design decision that has to be made early on in the development. 
But if you have other ideas do let me know. Customization is a big topic, and I'd love to include more options.

In the meantime, if you crave more Ghosthunting, I have made a demake that is free to play. A demake is an existing game reimagined for older hardware/consoles/platforms. It also features local multiplayer. 

[url=https://www.lexaloffle.com/bbs/?tid=43170]This[/url] is my demake of Ghostist.
You can find the controls in the description. 

Have fun, thank you all for stopping by, and have a great day.

taxicomics

notes.title: Possibly last early access upate
notes.content:
Hi everybody! 
Thanks again for your patience. After the early access I got great feedback, and hearing from you was honestly one of the best experiences I ever had in the creative field. Thanks again for that!
Some time after publishing I got tons of mail and messages, I got really excited. Turns out there are a lot of people trying to scam you for free games-which wouldn´t be thaaaat bad-but they are not interested in your game, they just want to resell the bounty on other pages. That´s how those cheap steamkeystores work. I got really frustrated with that and took a big break from gamedev.
But then I remembered all the nice people who helped me make this game a reality and slowly got back into it. Thanks for that!
I´m now putting the finishing touches on the game, so this might be the last update before full release, depending on the amount of bugs that you might find ^^ 

[list]
[h1]What´s new?[/h1]

[*] New Level (studio apartment)
[*] more music and better radio
[*] bugfixes, bugfixes, bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: The "Exorcist" - Update
notes.content:
[h2]NEW LATEGAME CONTENT[/h2]
This is a very experimental update. Every bit of feedback is highly appreciated!


[*] Ghosts were always able to hunt you, but now you can hunt back! Buy the Exorcismkit and banish the ghosts! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/8bf0de5f960406e633bccf9ce67f859fe5022ecd.png[/img]
[*] in order to banish ghosts you first need to be sure what type of ghost you are dealing with. And be absolutely sure! No ghost likes being taunted. 

[*] Collect all the bones scattered across the level.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/9d2f80336a190f8149b4e07c5fc99dbdf008f962.png[/img]

[*] Draw the correct symbol for each ghost
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/dd21421e07837ce2c696ad1ded9885069349102c.png[/img].

[h2]Ghosts can break your bones[/h2]
[list]
[*] aggressive ghosts will now break your bones to make your escape a little harder. Stock up on Medkits (new item!)
[/list]

[h2]various small stuff[/h2]
[list]
[*] nerfed the emf more, so now you need to be around the ghost longer
[*] improved lamps a little bit
[*] added the TV
[*] various tiny map changes
[*] lots of sound changes
[/list]

Have fun <3

notes.title: The Faster Better Stronger Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/a3da5d2112656f45ea07fafff898b81a81c48d04.png[/img]

[h1]This is a lot, so brace yourself[/h1]

We were hard at work and reworked a lot of the game based on your feedback. The artist did a wonderful job tweaking lots of big and small stuff. Let´s get started:

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Big Ghost-B-Gone Changes, it is now a much more important tool. All ghosts emit EMF's, but only some reach the tip of the scale
[*] Added the "expert guess" bonus for experienced hunters. If you have not yet experienced an effect but think you know which ghost you are dealing with you get a bonus if you´re right
[*] Ghosts really hate cross breezes now and are eager to close open doors
[*] Ghosts hate being constricted. That means less being stuck but also less catching the ghost with salt. Ghosts will now try to free themselves after some time
[*] changed cheats
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added coffee! Use it for big maps or just to increase your blood pressure
[/list]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Lots of big and small map changes, some changing features, some just adding bathrooms
[*] Added a new map! 
[/list]

[h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the tools in small and big ways, most prominent changes to the spirit box
[*] Lots of new bathroom stuff
[*] some new furniture
[*] changed the shadows
[*] added more lamps
[/list]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] small bugfixes
[*] got first hatemail
[*] got lots of very nice mail too!
[*] got excited for release on Tuesday
[/list]

notes.title: Feature Complete Version Is Out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/5194b5fdd4ecbaf4a3a877cddd2266baa106e665.gif[/img]
Hello dear paranormal friends! 
I know you have become great [b]ghostists[/b] on your journey through the betaphase of this game. Now it´s time to really get to work. There is a lot of new stuff here, so strap in:

[h1]What is new?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39868648/e8e2e481c97007e0d33b58c38f2a5f89c943e210.png[/img]
[list]
[*] added a new level
[*] added new control scheme
[*] rebalanced everything(but you beta testers get to keep your saves and all that money)
[*] changed the glowsticks a lot - they are now a toy ghosts enjoy to hate
[*] improved ghost hunting and wandering AI
[*] added statistics so you can keep track of your progress
[*] added upgrades to your base (earn 'em by doing a good job)
[*] added cheats for development but left them in for fun-try to find them!
[*] got real happy
[*] improved existing maps
[*] got the nicest betatesters in the world
[/list]

[h1]What got fixed?[/h1]
[list]
[*] had a talk with ghosts about their trips into walls(thanks corestrategy!)
[*] made the flashlight stop bending the laws of physics
[*] made the ghosts a little less snackish
[*] stopped the tutorial from invading missions(thanks michael and corestrategy!)
[*] got rid of the foggy indoors(thanks, yusuf!)
[/list]

[h1]What now?[/h1]
We´re very happy about this v1.0 release, every planned feature is now implemented. Now you, the community, can help to sculpt new ideas and give your feedback so more people can enjoy [b]Ghostist[/b] :)


If you have any problems don´t hesitate to contact us via Instagram or our Subreddit r/Ghostist.
There is one week left before release (2nd of March, next Tuesday), that should be enough time to discover and fix potential bugs. 
Thanks for your support so far, you´re really what kept me going,
taxicomics
